latest_release.name: v0.10.0-beta
latest_release.body:
### Features
  - Added `textStream()` to `Blob`, `Request` and `Response` (@nabetti1720)
  - Added `latin1`, `binary`, `ascii` and `base64url` encodings to `Buffer` (@arxhr007)
  - Added a MkDocs documentation site (@richarddavison)

### Fixes
  - Honor `totalLength` in `Buffer.concat` (@arxhr007)
  - Fix `structuredClone` crashing on `DataView` and align `structuredClone`, `URLSearchParams` and `Headers` with the specification (@arxhr007)
  - Fix `structuredClone` transfer handling and Web Streams conformance (@nabetti1720)
  - Fix Streams edge cases uncovered by the expanded WPT coverage (@nabetti1720)
  - Fix encoding streams behavior and share the WTF-8 encoding logic (@nabetti1720)
  - Correct Windows-1252 and streaming decoder behavior (@nabetti1720)
  - Do not synthesize an `Origin` header in server-side fetch (@nabetti1720)
  - Combine repeated response header values in fetch (@dills122)
  - Normalize network access policy matching in fetch (@dills122)
  - Resolve relative redirects with canonical origins in fetch (@dills122)
  - Enforce `LLRT_NET_ALLOW` and `LLRT_NET_DENY` for sockets and `dgram`, including bare-host, IPv6 and unix-socket entries (@richarddavison)
  - Look up SDK service endpoints by package directory, fixing the endpoints for SecretsManager and Cognito Identity Provider (@richarddavison)
  - Fix cyclic CommonJS requires with normalized paths (@nabetti1720)
  - Resolve the `module` field as ESM and fix the bridge for CommonJS modules with no named exports (@nabetti1720)
  - Fix package subpath resolution with explicit extensions (@nabetti1720)
  - Keep leading parent segments and relative roots in `path.join` and `path.normalize` (@Arthur031221)
  - Ensure the console initializes primordials (@ahaoboy)
  - Fix WASI compilation (@andreiltd)
  - Refresh `os.networkInterfaces()` and the `os.cpus()` frequency on every call instead of returning the values captured on first use (@richarddavison)
  - Parse JSON containing lone surrogate escapes correctly with simd-json 0.19 (@richarddavison)
  - Avoid pulling in unused crypto backend dependencies (@dills122)

### Maintenance
  - Make Intl/Temporal (`intl402`) and post-quantum algorithms (`pqc`) opt-in Cargo features, and reduce the release binary size by ~10% (11.5MB to 10.4MB on arm64 musl) with extra musl codegen/linker flags and de-genericized stream promise helpers (@richarddavison)
  - Replace the custom zig linker wrapper scripts with cargo-zigbuild (@richarddavison)
  - Upgrade rquickjs to 0.14 (@richarddavison)
  - Require rsa 0.10.0-rc.19 in `llrt_crypto` (@richarddavison)
  - Improve WPT harness compatibility and skip browser-only and invalid-URL WPT cases (@nabetti1720)
  - Stabilize console error-stack test fixtures (@dills122)
  - Dependency upgrades

Thanks for all the reports and contributors

Full list of changes:
https://github.com/awslabs/llrt/compare/v0.9.0-beta...v0.10.0-beta
